answer.rationale: Use the confirmed shortened-onboarding improvement: completion rose 13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention increased 3%. Do not counter with broad promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment lifted acquisition and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention 12%, conflicting with the sustainable-revenue objective. Onboarding does not directly resolve churn among existing price-sensitive accounts, so that limitation should be monitored while avoiding an unproven price war.
